title: The keyboard layout system tray layout icon is invisible but still takes up space if no layout is configured and all applets are forced to be visible
line: The Keyboard Layout widget shows the layout in use ("us") instead of a blank space when no layout is configured.
explanation: With no layout in kxkbrc, locale1 or XKB_DEFAULT_LAYOUT (the reporter's Gentoo has no system default), libxkbcommon compiles its built-in default layout (us), but KWin built its layout list from the empty rule names it passed in. So KWin reported the working layout with an empty short name, and the Keyboard Layout widget drew nothing in its force-shown tray slot. KWin now takes the layout list from the names libxkbcommon actually resolves (xkb_components_names_from_rules, libxkbcommon 1.9+), so every consumer gets 'us'; older libxkbcommon keeps the current behaviour.

commits.message:
xkb: report the default layout when none is configured

With no layout in kxkbrc, locale1 or XKB_DEFAULT_LAYOUT, libxkbcommon
uses its own default but the layout list stayed empty, so the layout had
no short name. Take the list from the names libxkbcommon resolves.

BUG: 522449

media.caption: No layout configured, no system default, tray showing all entries: blank slot after the mouse icon
Same setup with the KWin fix: the slot shows 'us', the layout actually in use

review.text: Clean, minimal root-cause fix in the right layer (KWin's Xkb class) rather than papering over empty short names in the applet. Resolving the default layout via libxkbcommon's xkb_components_names_from_rules (guarded for libxkbcommon >= 1.9.0 alongside the existing version check) ensures every consumer sees the active default layout with no leaks or regressions, and the screenshots and autotests thoroughly verify the fix. Adding Q_UNUSED(context) for the < 1.9.0 build branch is a tiny nitpick that does not block merging.

reviews.text: Clean, minimal root-cause fix in the right layer (KWin's Xkb class) rather than papering over empty short names in the applet. Resolving the default layout via libxkbcommon's xkb_components_names_from_rules (guarded for libxkbcommon >= 1.9.0 alongside the existing version check) ensures every consumer sees the active default layout with no leaks or regressions, and the screenshots and autotests thoroughly verify the fix. Adding Q_UNUSED(context) for the < 1.9.0 build branch is a tiny nitpick that does not block merging.

Right layer: KWin built m_layoutList from the empty rule names while libxkbcommon silently compiled its own default, so every consumer got an empty short name; taking the list from xkb_components_names_from_rules (1.9+, out-strings are not caller-owned) fixes it for the widget and everyone else, with an old-libxkbcommon fallback. Showing 'us' is the honest UX for the reporter's force-shown slot, and the before/after tray crops plus getLayoutsList output prove it, with sensible multi-layout/variant regression checks. Nit only: the libxkbcommon docs call this function mainly a debugging helper, so a reviewer may ask about it, but there is no better public API for the resolved layout list.
